frontmatter.sidebar_description: Fetch a shipping option for an order.

blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `fetchShippingOptionForOrderWorkflow`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This workflow fetches a shipping option for an order. It's used in Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) flows. It's used
by other workflows, such as [createClaimShippingMethodWorkflow](/references/medusa-workflows/createClaimShippingMethodWorkflow).

You can use this workflow within your customizations or your own custom workflows, allowing you to wrap custom logic around fetching
shipping options for an order.

steps.name: setCalculatedShippingPricingContext
steps.description:
This hook is executed before the
calculated shipping methods' prices are refreshed. You can consume it to return
any custom context that is merged into the `context` parameter of the
fulfillment provider's `calculatePrice` method (framework-provided properties
take precedence on a naming conflict).

steps.name: calculateShippingOptionsPricesStep
steps.description: This step calculates the prices for one or more shipping options.

children.name: AdditionalData
children.description:
Additional data, passed through the `additional_data` property accepted in HTTP
requests, that allows passing custom data and handle them in hooks.

Learn more in [this documentation](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/api-routes/additional-data).

children.name: shipping_option_id
children.description: The ID of the shipping option to fetch.

children.name: custom_amount
children.description:
The custom amount of the shipping option.
If not provided, the shipping option's amount is used.

children.name: currency_code
children.description: The currency code of the order.

children.name: context
children.description:
The context of the RMA flow, which can be useful for retrieving the shipping option's price.
Optional for non-RMA flows such as draft orders.
